messages:
sam_k: quick heads-up — after the RBAC refactor merged this morning, a customer on private control-plane reported that their admin can no longer list KMS keys. saw it in support ticket #4721.
elaine_s: ugh, which binding changed?
mike_infra: the pr removed the legacy `controlplane:admin` clusterrole and replaced with scoped roles. looks like allowlist mapping didn't include `kms:ListKeys` for private-controlplane-admin.
sam_k: exact error from their logs: `AccessDeniedException: User arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/pcp-admin/... is not authorized to perform: kms:ListKeys`
elaine_s: can someone confirm whether this is a policy generation bug or an allowlist omission during role-mapping?
alyssa_ps: onprem & dedicated have slightly different policy templates. my hunch: the template generator skipped KMS perms when vpc_allowlist=true. odd.
mike_infra: adding my quick repro steps:
```
# using pcp-admin service account
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::... --role-session-name test
aws kms list-keys --region us-west-2
# -> AccessDeniedException
```
sam_k: reaction :eyes: we should triage as P1 for customer impact, but no key exfil risk.
deploy-bot: deploy 2024.03.18-rc3 started by mike_infra (sha: b7a9f2)
elaine_s: ok plan: 1) add temporary allowlist exception to map kms:ListKeys and kms:DescribeKey to pcp-admin role for that tenant, 2) patch policy-gen to include KMS perms when controlplane_admin role is generated, 3) add unit test for vpc_allowlist=true case.
alyssa_ps: also add audit log flag to record which generated policy was applied to each tenant for 30d — will help root cause.
mike_infra: I'll push hotfix and revert if anything breaks. rolling to staging then prod. ETA 45m.
sam_k: cc @oncall: please monitor KMS deny spikes for the tenant and escalate if we see reauth storms.
alyssa_ps: filing a follow-up eval to ensure quantization of role templates doesn't drop critical perms (joke but also serious). :slightly_smiling_face:
elaine_s: thanks. saving support ticket reply: "we've identified an RBAC generation gap affecting KMS listing for private control-plane admins; hotfix rolling, ETA ~45m. will follow up with postmortem."
sam_k: nice. keep thread updated with prod timestamps and audit log ids.
